name: 日付移動・表示単位・集計方法・保存の負荷操作帯
prompt: Create a Japanese-localized visual replica of the exact Asana toolbar strip shown by the primary source crop. This is an extremely wide, very short toolbar; keep the output as an ultra-wide, shallow strip around 28.8:1, about 1555 × 54 proportions. Do not add any outer blank canvas, browser chrome, page background, panels, title, content rows, shadows, marketing art, extra controls, or new labels. Reproduce only these controls in the source order and with the source's broad spacing: a white rounded outlined button with one small red circle containing a white plus and the label 「作業を追加」; a left chevron, 「今日」, and a right chevron; 「日付なし（1）」; a subtle vertical divider; a small gray magnifier with plus and 「日ごと（小）」; divider; a light gray filter-lines icon and 「条件」; divider; a circled-check icon and 「作業数」; divider; a sliders icon and 「設定」; underlined 「フィードバックを送信」; then a white rounded outlined 「保存」 button with a separate narrow dropdown-chevron segment. Preserve the source's thin neutral outlines, gray utility icons, dark gray labels, bright white background and the lone red plus marker. Use crisp small Meiryo-style Japanese UI typography, regular weight, no tracking, no bold display heading. Keep a single straight baseline and extremely low height; controls must not overlap or wrap. The main source crop controls exact geometry and controls. The Japanese mock is secondary for localized labels and must not override visible original controls.
reviewNotes: Compared visually with the original Asana toolbar crop and saved Japanese mock. All original control groups are present in source order, including the source-only Send feedback link, with Japanese labels and the single red add marker. The internal toolbar spacing and control silhouette are broadly retained, but material canvas geometry remains: generated file is a roughly 3:1 landscape with the roughly 28.8:1 toolbar centered in a large blank vertical field; source region is 1555x54. The image generator did not produce the requested shallow canvas. Utility icon strokes, exact font metrics, and button geometry are approximations. Keep as a correction-needed raster candidate; native editability and application behavior are unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
